data.name: Hareshbhai
data.gender_notes: Hareshbhai is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hareshbhai is a Sanskrit name derived from the compound of Hara (God of Gods) and Ishwara (Supreme God). This name is believed to represent the divine presence and power of the deity Shiva. The name Hareshbhai carries the meaning “God of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hareshbhai usually hope their child will grow to embody god of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Hareshbhai belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hareshbhai total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
